Make Blackjack – In this card game, making a Blackjack means finishing precisely on 21. If you can pull this off with only your first two cards, you’ll earn a 3:2 payout.
As Bovada Casino’s primary version of Blackjack, this card game is played using a total of six decks.
The decks are shuffled after every hand, just like at a live casino.
You can also boost your winnings by doubling down and splitting whenever the opportunity should present itself.
With a huge max bet of $2,500 and the ability to play up to three hands at once, you can win a huge payday playing Blackjack.
Just as the name suggests, Single Deck Blackjack takes things back to the basics by playing with just a single deck of cards that gets shuffled after every hand.
Featuring two decks in the shoe, this version of the famous casino game provides yet another option for online Blackjack players at Bovada Casino.
This game includes all of the same rules as Single Deck Blackjack, but has twice as many aces and face cards in the deck.
Just remember this game only allows you to split once per round and features a maximum bet of $250 per hand.
Classic Single Deck Blackjack allows Bovada players to combine the excitement of Single Deck Blackjack with the realistic gameplay of Classic Blackjack. The rules and betting limits are the same as Single Deck Blackjack so there are no surprises, but you can enjoy the feeling of sitting at a virtual table and handling your virtual chips.
The European version of this famous table game functions similarly to the standard version of the game, however there is one key difference – in the European version, the dealer doesn’t receive a second card until after the player has made their decision, including doubling and splitting.
With every other aspect of the game unchanged, European Blackjack can be a good choice for players looking to switch things up on the felt.
This innovative game allows you to play Blackjack online against real dealers that are streaming live from a studio, letting you interact with a real live casino.

At Bovada, you can double any two cards when you play Single Deck Blackjack, and the Dealer must hit on Soft 17.
In both Single Deck Blackjack variants at Bovada, you’re allowed to double on any two cards you’re dealt – and you can double down after a split.
In both the Classic and New versions, the dealer must hit on soft 17.

When you play Single Deck Blackjack at Bovada using the new format, you may split up to two hands; with the Classic format, you get to split up to three hands.
Split Aces receive only one card in both versions.
In short, you get improved functionality when you play The New Blackjack at Bovada, but if you’re playing Single Deck Blackjack using the new layout, you lose the ability to split up to three times. Otherwise, the same Blackjack rules apply when it comes to the Dealer hitting on soft 17, Blackjacks paying out at 3:2, and so on.

If you already know how to play Blackjack, then Perfect Pairs will be easy for you to grasp. The blackjack portion of the game remains the same; just like Classic Blackjack, there are six decks in the shoe, the dealer hits on soft 17, you can split up to three hands, and surrenders are allowed.

When you play live Casino online, you can watch every action of the dealer, from shuffling cards to spinning the roulette wheel. Even though RNG games are 100% trustworthy and are designed to keep online casino games safe and fully randomized, a live dealer helps some players trust the fairness of the game even more.
Both varieties of roulette – American and European – are available live, and certain Blackjack tables offer Early Payout as an option.

Super 6 is a fun and exciting table game featuring plenty of betting options. The game is very similar to baccarat, but there are a few key differences that make it all its own.
The game is played with a six-deck shoe and the Live Casino feature allows you to see the actual cards being dealt right before your eyes.
Player bets pay out even money, as do Banker bets (minus a five percent commission), while a Tie bet pays out 8:1. The primary difference with Super 6 is this – if the Banker wins with a total of 6, the payout is 1:2 (or in other words, you’ll win half of what you bet).
Another popular side bet in Live Casino Super 6 is the Pairs wager. This bet wins if the first two cards dealt to the Player or the Banker combine to make a pair. For example, if the first two cards dealt are 10-10 or K-K, the side bet is deemed a winner. This side bet also has a generous payout at 11:1. There’s also the Either Pair side bet option, which works the same way but applies to both the Banker and Dealer’s hand, and comes with 5:1 payout odds.

Bovada Casino has both American Roulette and European Roulette tables available. While both games are similar, there’s a distinct difference between the two types of online roulette; European Roulette features a wheel with 37 slots and only a single zero (0), while American Roulette uses a wheel with 38 slots with two zeros (0, 00).
Flash Roulette at Bovada uses a European-style wheel with 37 numbers (0-36) and allows for both inside and outside bets, similar to traditional roulette.
